entry.title: EffectWerk 0.0.5
entry.summary: **EffectForce is now EffectWerk: a new name, the same effect rack.** <!-- werk-rename: keep --> "Force" is the name of Akai's device, so it no longer belongs in this plugin's name. The sound stays the same, apart from the Delay fix below. - MPC's plugin list shows **EffectWerk**, and the plugin lives in `/sdcard/Synths/Devko - VST - EffectWerk`. - Your presets, favorites and recents move over by themselves: the installer carries them out of the old `Devko - VST - EffectForce` folder and removes
